basis.finding: 0 candidates in all markets. The funnel collapses between universe and evaluation: KR 2766->3, US 13214->2, Crypto 282->0. Causes: no full-universe price history (KR 1-2 sessions kept, US 18 symbols), no stock-to-sector/theme membership, evaluators bound to fixed tiny symbol sets, identity ratifications KR 3 / US 0 / Crypto 1, and no committed regime-permits-buy rule.

tier_model.T1_DISCOVERY: Daily per market: universe -> regime (displayed) -> strong rotation sectors/themes -> ranked stocks within them, with reasons. Display/observation only; no authority.
tier_model.T2_PAPER_CANDIDATE: Eligible for internal PAPER trading only when all minimum required conditions hold. The remaining evidence (business translation, expectations gap, invalidation, veto, evidence quality) is scoring and warnings, not hard blockers, at this tier.
tier_model.T3_REAL_CANDIDATE: All 9 Stage3 gates PASS + PAPER performance evidence + explicit user approval. REAL remains prohibited today (P11 unchanged).

liquidity at or above a ratified market threshold (Upbit threshold already ratified; KR and US thresholds pending separate user decision; until ratified, KR/US T2 liquidity condition = NOT_EVALUATED and T2 is not granted)
